recent: DC Healthcare 近期完成以 RM8 million 现金收购一栋三层店铺单位，并宣布在半岛马来西亚新增四家诊所。公司也发布了最新季度业绩，营收环比增长 5.9%，净利环比大幅上升。
notable: 完成以 RM8 million 现金收购一栋三层店铺单位。
在半岛马来西亚新增四家诊所，扩展诊所网络。
董事 Dr Chong Tze Sheng 和 Dr Lai Ngan Chee 在公开市场增持股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM22.618 million，环比增长 5.9%，同比增长 9.8%；净利为 RM469,000，净利率 2.1%，高于上季度的 0.6%。

recent_en: DC Healthcare recently completed the cash acquisition of a three-storey shoplot for RM8 million and announced four new clinic openings across Peninsular Malaysia. The company also released its latest quarterly results, with revenue up 5.9% QoQ and net profit rising sharply QoQ.
notable_en: Completed the cash acquisition of a three-storey shoplot for RM8 million.
Opened four new clinics across Peninsular Malaysia, expanding its clinic network.
Directors Dr Chong Tze Sheng and Dr Lai Ngan Chee acquired shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM22.618 million, up 5.9% QoQ and 9.8% YoY; net profit was RM469,000 with a net margin of 2.1%, up from 0.6% in the previous quarter.
